subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent managed plugin installation in core now, and what contract should it use for install record identity, uninstall/update behavior, runtime discovery, and trust boundaries?
rationale: This is a new public CLI and persisted config surface that affects plugin code execution, so correctness depends on product/security semantics that the current branch does not establish.

options.title: Pause for scoped plugin contract
options.body: Keep this PR open or ask for a revision after maintainers define the end-to-end install, uninstall, update, discovery, and trust semantics.

options.title: Narrow to a design issue first
options.body: Close or pause the implementation branch and continue the feature discussion in the linked issue until the API and security contract are approved.

options.title: Accept install-only semantics
options.body: Merge the install-only surface and intentionally own the stranded-management and runtime-scope risk until follow-up work lands.

recommendation.title: Pause for scoped plugin contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open or ask for a revision after maintainers define the end-to-end install, uninstall, update, discovery, and trust semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership across plugin install, registry, and docs surfaces touched by this product contract.
